title: Chapter 140 Battle Of The Strong
content:
Chapter 140 Battle Of The Strong

In just a moment, the endless terrifying sword intent suddenly covered the entire void.

Seeing this shocking scene, the entire Divine Dynasty trembled.

Is this the sword intent that reaches the gods? !

And the target of these sword intents is Jiangbei, who is not far in front of Jian Xin.

"Concentrate."

Jian Xin's red lips opened slightly.

All the sword intents began to gather immediately.

Buzz——

A sword light with a hissing sound appeared in Jian Xin's palm.

"Go."

As soon as the voice fell, the sword light shot towards Jiangbei in the distance at a terrifying speed.

Seeing this attack, the strong men of the Divine Dynasty were excited.

The sword intent of the second general is more terrifying than before.

In the void.

Jiangbei looked at this attack without fear.

He knew that this was just a test from the opponent.

Suddenly, a martial arts state of mind condensed from his palm, and the next moment, Jiangbei punched out.

Boom!

The terrifying explosion sounded throughout the Divine Dynasty.

The entire void began to shatter.

Seeing that the battle was about to affect the people below, several powerful figures suddenly soared into the sky and jointly cast a barrier to protect the battlefield of the two.

"This is too terrifying."

Looking at the Sword God and the God of War fighting above, countless people sighed.

This realm is something that countless people can never reach in their lifetime.

In the Imperial Palace.

Old Zhou stood behind Yan Lingyun, watching the battle between the two with a serious expression.

In his opinion, the strength of these two people is definitely at the top of this universe.

It can be said that they are on par.

So if you want to decide the winner, you don’t have to show some real skills. That’s impossible.

And now, the two are still just testing each other.

Slightly sideways, looking at Yan Lingyun on the side, I saw that Yan Lingyun was just watching silently, and there was no intention to stop it.

Old Zhou sighed in his heart and said nothing.

"Stop hiding your strength."

In the void, Jian Xin suddenly spoke coldly.

Jiang Bei smiled when he heard it.

"Aren't you the same?"

Looking at Jiang Bei for a long time, Jian Xin suddenly tightened her sword.

I have to say that she did underestimate Jiang Bei.

After all, she has been in the realm of the Sword God for many years.

Although Jiang Bei's martial arts aura is at the realm of the Martial God, it is a little immature. He thought he would win the game, but he had no way to deal with the opponent.

After taking a deep breath, the sword in Jian Xin's hand suddenly began to buzz.

The next moment, countless sharp sword intents rushed out from the magic sword.

In an instant, countless sword shadows transformed by sword intent appeared in the void.

"This move, let's see how you break it?"

Countless sword shadows flew directly towards Jiang Bei.

Looking at the countless sword shadows, Jiang Bei's expression was slightly solemn. This guy really hid his strength.

The power of each sword shadow can match the first attack.

It is extremely terrifying.

He is worthy of being the Sword God.

However, I am not bad either.

Jiang Bei suddenly rushed towards Jian Xin in the distance, and his speed was extremely fast, which shocked Jian Xin a little.

Seeing Jiang Bei's thoughts, Jian Xin hurriedly retreated. At the same time, countless sword shadows still came behind Jiang Bei.

Seeing that Jiang Bei was about to be hit, Jian Xin frowned.

This guy didn't avoid it?

Sure enough, the next moment, Jiang Bei's speed suddenly increased again, and he appeared directly in front of Jian Xin.

"What!"

Suddenly, countless exclamations sounded.

Everyone looked at Jiang Bei in the void in astonishment.

This guy hides his strength very well. With this speed, he is almost still invincible.

Everyone only thought that Jiang Bei, as a martial god, possessed absolute power, but ignored Jiang Bei's speed.

Never expected that Jiang Bei, with his powerful strength, could possess such a terrifying speed.

At this moment, Jian Xin was also shocked.

But her reaction was not slow. When Jiang Bei appeared in front of her, the sword in her hand had already stabbed out.

Unfortunately, it was a bit hasty after all.

In addition, she had just retreated, and the sword no longer had the sharpness at the beginning.

A roar sounded.

Jian Xin immediately retreated violently.

However, the next moment, everyone was dumbfounded again.

Before Jian Xin could stabilize his body, Jiang Bei's figure had already appeared in front of Jian Xin again.

Boom!

Another explosion.

Jian Xin retreated violently again.

Seeing this scene, the strong men of the Divine Dynasty suddenly looked ugly.

It's over.

Completely suppressed.

One wrong step, all wrong steps.

Originally, the situation was evenly matched, but now Jiang Bei found a breakthrough point.

That was the God of War, invincible in close combat. Although Jian Xin's sword intent was not weak, she didn't even have the chance to display it at this moment.

Jian Xin's expression was a little ugly at this moment.

She was completely suppressed at this moment.

Jiang Bei didn't give her a chance to resist. Every attack was closely connected, and she couldn't react at all.

So now the only thing she could do was to wait.

Wait for the only chance.

After an unknown amount of time, a muffled sound sounded.

Jian Xin suddenly spit out a mouthful of blood.

She took Jiang Bei's last blow.

In return, Jian Xin successfully broke away and got a chance to counterattack.

"God Killer!"

Buzz——

A terrifying blood-red sword light suddenly slashed out from Jian Xin's sword.

The breath was extremely terrifying.

Wherever it passed, the entire space left a crack that could not be restored for a long time.

"The Sword God is angry."

Looking at the terrifying sword light, a strong man from the Divine Dynasty said with some fear.

It has been many years since I saw Jian Xin use this move.

This move once killed a super-god realm strongman with one sword, which can be said to be a blockbuster.

Facing this sword, I don't know how Jiang Bei will respond.

In the void.

Jiang Bei's expression was also a little solemn.

Jiang Bei took a step forward, and then one of the countless martial arts began to condense.

"Smashing God Fist!"

Boom!

A pale yellow fist light rushed out directly.

The next moment, the two attacks collided with each other.

Crack!

A crisp sound rang out.

The entire barrier suddenly shattered into nothingness.

"Not good!"

"Stop it!"

Instantly, countless strong men rushed into the void and used their divine power to stop the aftermath.

However, when everyone turned around and looked at the battle between Jiang Bei and Jian Xin, they gasped.

They saw that the space had completely become nothingness.

Countless terrifying black holes continued to pour out and explode from there.

It was extremely terrifying.

How much power was used.

Everyone couldn't help but sigh.

At this time, Jiang Bei and Jian Xin had already suffered a lot of injuries, but at this moment they were already fighting with real fire.

They couldn't stop at all.

"Come again!"

Swish!

Suddenly, the two shot at each other again.

Just as the two were about to collide again, a cold voice suddenly sounded from the field.

"Enough."

The next moment, a noble figure appeared between the two.

Seeing the identity of the person in front of him, Jian Xin looked panicked.

"Your Majesty!"

Jiang Bei also frowned.

"Get out of the way!"
